note: World-setting motions for everyday, birth and aquatic behaviors. Whole-body root transforms (scale, rotation, lift, shift) landed on the lowest visible point every sample, small hand-bone flourishes where hand bones carry hair, and per-clip expression timelines. Amplitudes are degrees, fractions of the body height or scale ratios. Times are seconds. A face timeline entry is [start, end, expression]; a missing texture falls back along `face_fallback`, and the server's injury face wins over the timeline (`expression_yield`). `applies` lists the models a clip is compiled into (fnmatch patterns; `except` removes).

paddle_shared.note: Project design: the paddle stick's gate and target parameters shared by boat_paddle, hat_brim_offer and boat_nudge_young; the captain rows facing her hull's bow (Paddle.FACING: within captain_yaw degrees), the stick over the beam; the braid hangs from its root (the clip's braid_out) and `curl` bends each joint below the root outboard (degrees, braid_1 to the tuft), so the tip reaches over the gunwale (user 2026-11-02: no stiff lift or inverted U); the blade follows aquatic_tools.stroke (shared with bank_beckon's tuft): under the water by the clip's `depth` through the whole power half, out over `entry` of the phase at the start of the recovery to `air` plus an `arc` just over the surface and back in over its last `entry` (user 2026-11-02: lower, really sliding in the water, no hover); a clip's own paddle block overrides keys (aim keys merge one level). The captain's mass is not stored: aquatic_tools derives it from body_geometry.json (marisa bounds) and Buoyancy.BODY_DENSITY.

boat_braid.note: Project design (lily-pad hull, 2026-11-01): in the boat the seated captain lays her braid out over the brim on her braid side, its tuft just past the brim edge over the water (the basin floor beside her is too narrow for the tuft; the floor stays for the young and the stores). Seat-frame model units of the tuft end (braid_path key rest).

hat_stumble.label: 帽檐失衡压低撑稳
hat_stumble.lore: Server-timed rider balance: compress, brace the hair against the brim and take small supported steps. Real seat travel, pivot and falling belong to the boat; no visual jump or enlarged newborn.

hat_jostle.label: 拥挤中抵住让步
hat_jostle.lore: A real contact-pressure session makes room with two low bracing beats. The server moves feet along support and alone decides whether a rider crosses the brim.

water_plunge.label: 落水冲击闭眼收身
water_plunge.lore: The synchronized twelve-tick IMPACT phase: brief compression and a frightened cry, then raise the face. Root translation stays zero; no grounded correction or artificial buoyancy. v14: pitch limited to -12..+10, roll 6.

water_struggle.label: 朝救援侧抬脸扑水呼救
water_struggle.lore: Only the server's bounded effort window enables the strong asymmetric hair strokes. Rescue direction is the actual entity yaw; body pitch raises the mouth then presses down. Hair sweeps do not propel or float the entity. v14: pitch limited to 10, roll 6; effort is squash and braid strokes. v17: only a braid-carrying hand bone strokes; plain side hair (hand_left on Marisa) only follows the body.

water_swim.label: 落水后定神划水游
water_swim.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-04: swimming back to the hat must not twitch at the start): purposeful swimming (Swim) after the plunge's shock, instead of water_struggle's distress jerks. Its first frame is water_plunge's last, so the shock flows straight into the first stroke without a reset; each loop starts at rest: the body glides while a carried braid swings forward to the catch, then surges a little on the pull (power_start..power_end: the braid drawn back down and out, pitch +5 to +2, a squash, a slight yaw and roll toward the stroke); plain side hair only follows. No root track: the server owns the travel. water_struggle stays for distress without a swim, water_gasp for real exhaustion.
triggers: Swim running with paid effort while not EXHAUSTED

water_gasp.label: 力竭停顿低伏喘息
water_gasp.lore: Between real attempts or in EXHAUSTED: low body, one small breath and a weak lock twitch, with no rising root track. Sinking, injury and rescue remain server physics.

water_recover.label: 获救后伏低喘息回望
water_recover.lore: Only after a real supported recovery: crouch, take two shallow breaths and look back for family before returning to neutral. This awards no health or energy and never fakes a rescue.

boat_reassure.label: 亲友稳身轻声回应
boat_reassure.lore: A safely supported parent or friend faces the distressed child with concern, leans slightly and calls with a low braid gesture. Actual approach, rescue contact and relationship response stay on the server.

boat_carry_young.label: 扶携子油跨过帽阶
boat_carry_young.lore: A real parent holds its dependent child at the synchronized carry anchor while following a supported hat route. The parent stays steady until the child is set down.

boat_be_carried.label: 被亲油扶携收身
boat_be_carried.lore: A carried child tucks its body; all travel and release belong to the parent's actual server carry state, never a child jump or free flight.

hat_walk.label: 帽内伏身挪步
hat_walk.lore: Supported short steps along the server-planned hat surface route. Root translation belongs to the route; the body compresses and releases on the same 24-tick cadence.
triggers: hat_walk while actually traversing a supported route

care_finish.label: 留在身边等照料结束
care_finish.lore: A parent remains at the contact position through swallowing or the end of toileting before either participant returns.

nest_harvest.label: 贴近叶丛衔取材料
nest_harvest.lore: Reach toward a real leaf or grass block, grip and draw back; one finite portion is removed only after sustained reachable contact.

nest_place.label: 低头放下叶束
nest_place.lore: Place one carried portion on the assigned bed. Material ownership and construction progress live in the shelter.

nest_spread.label: 左右摊开铺叶

nest_press.label: 伏身压实床面
nest_press.lore: Two shallow grounded presses settle the current bedding layer. No visual jumping or completion before the full work is done.

shelter_dig.label: 刨土挖洞
shelter_dig.lore: Project design (FG-01, user 2026-11-13: when it opens its own den the braid must work too; body-is-ability). Standing at the soil face it scrapes, one stroke a loop: it leans and pushes in against the face (reach, to the lean_keys peak), drags back with a little squash of effort and a yaw twist as the soil comes loose (scrape marker: the server's soil spray and scrape sound fall on it), and comes upright again. Pitch, and roll where a variant sets it, stay within the 12 degree budget. Without a braid the body alone does the work; Marisa's braid (variant) reaches forward and down to the face, drags the loosened soil down it and sweeps it out along the ground to her braid side before swinging back to rest (braid_keys.py lays the chain and gates it against her body, hat and the floor). A braid that already holds something keeps its hold (not a braid_use clip) and the body scrapes alone.
triggers: shelter_dig (HabitatLife DIG at the reach cell, standing)

boat_paddle.label: 辫端持枝划船
boat_paddle.lore: EH22-005 braid-held stick (the real vanilla stick she picked up; yukkuri make no tools); N09 mouth-held stick is a documented alternative. Project design: the braid tuft wraps the stick's top; the power half (markers power_start..power_end) draws the lower end aft through the water, the blade in from the catch to the finish (aquatic_tools.stroke) with a small root swing (braid_sweep) and the lower braid turning after the stick, the recovery curls the tail further out (braid_raise, a share of paddle_shared.curl), lifting the stick out and swinging it forward. Body pitch -5..+1.5, roll <= 1, a shoulder yaw twist and a drive squash leading the braid by body_lead_seconds. Braid bend and the hull gate: contact-safe/README.md.
triggers: server surface route has a real stick and a waypoint

boat_paddle_braid.label: 无棍用辫子划水
boat_paddle_braid.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-05 feedback 8: rowing without a stick the braid must really touch the water): boat_paddle's stroke with the bare braid. Seated low in the basin her braid only reaches the water beyond the brim when she leans out to her braid side (`lean` degrees of roll, her pitch scaled by `pitch_share` so the two stay within 12; `lean_out` an [x, z] shift that way and a little forward, so her rear hair stays off the basin wall) and draws the braid taut over the brim (`lean_stretch`, up to that share longer along it, as hat.py stretches it), from the catch through the pull. The tuft end follows `braid_path` as one closed curve (`braid_curve` loop): from the shared boat rest tuck out and down into the water at the catch (power_start), drawn aft under the hull's waterline (`stroke.water` hull: hull_forms, the waterline boat_paddle's blade aims under; at least half `stroke.depth` under through the whole power half) to the finish (power_end), lifted out and swung back to the rest tuck. The loop's seam (t=0) is the rest tuck with her upright, so a drift turn hands over without a jump. Markers `contact` and `stroke` are where the tuft really enters and leaves the water (aquatic_tools.stroke_gate); hull_gate keeps the braid out of the hull.
triggers: server surface route without a stick (Paddle, bare braid)

bank_beckon.label: 岸边用辫子拨水
bank_beckon.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-02: near the bank the hat is stroked in, the braid really in the water): Beckon ashore with the bare braid. She turns her braid side to the water before her, flattens on the bank edge and sinks toward that side; the tuft end follows `stroke`'s stroke (aquatic_tools.stroke, shared with the stick blade): in at the catch, drawn toward the bank under the surface through the power half (power_start..power_end), lifted just over the water and swung back out in the recovery. `stroke` is in model units from her feet in the bank's frame (-z toward the water): `water` the flush bank's surface (a vanilla source block 8/9 high), `edge` the farthest the bank can reach before her (Beckon's stroke point: half her width's diagonal and .05 block), `turn` her yaw, `lean_out` her shift toward the water; `root_support` bank: her lowest body point (no braid) stands on the bank top. Gate: aquatic_tools.stroke_gate. Markers `contact` and `stroke` are where the tuft really enters and leaves the water (gated): Beckon pushes the hat only between them, once per loop.
triggers: Beckon: her own hat afloat within a braid stroke of the bank where she stands

water_beckon.label: 游在帽旁用辫子拨水
water_beckon.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-04: within three blocks the hat is drawn in by stroking the water, beyond that she swims to it): Beckon while she swims beside her own hat. Treading water she turns her braid side to the hat (`turn`; Beckon faces the hat), leans 7-9 degrees into each stroke with the face kept up, and the tuft end follows `stroke` (aquatic_tools.stroke, as bank_beckon): in at the catch out toward the hat, drawn in to her side under the surface through the power half, lifted clear of the water and swung back out in the recovery. `stroke` is in model units from her bottom in that frame (-z toward the hat); `water` is the assumed floating waterline (the body floats about half under; a waterline 1 lower or higher still wets and clears the tuft). Markers `contact` and `stroke` are where the tuft enters and leaves that water (gated): the push lies between them. Gate: aquatic_tools.stroke_gate.
triggers: Beckon: swimming within braid reach of her own hat afloat (three blocks or nearer)

braid_eat.label: 辫梢把食物送进嘴里
braid_eat.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-17 feedback 24: eating gets a braid-to-mouth beat, mixed at random with eating straight with the mouth; scavenging a bin especially needs it). Body-is-ability: the braid is Marisa's only limb. The food lies where the mouth would have bitten it (just before her lips, ItemContact reach), which the braid cannot reach from her side, so she turns her braid side toward it (yaw, unlimited) and leans in a little while the tuft curls down onto it (pick: the real stack leaves its source into the braid tuft once, drawn at the clip field tip), turns back while the braid swings it up in front of her face (lift) and brings it to her lips' braid-side corner (mouth: the stack moves from the tuft into the mouth once, the meal starts there; the tip then sits at HeldItemPresentation LIPS_CORNER on the mouth anchor), bites with a small chomp and lets the braid fall back to rest while the face starts chewing. The last 0.5 s is the meal's take-food beat and ends on eat's own first pose (lean end_lean with eat's mouth_comp), so the eat loop takes over unseen. Tilt (pitch plus roll) stays within 9 degrees. Chain key poses and gate: braid_keys.py.
triggers: meal start with the braid (ground food, bowl): random alternative to eating straight with the mouth

braid_eat_bin.label: 辫梢从倒下的垃圾桶里掏出食物送进嘴里
braid_eat_bin.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-17 feedback 24: rummaging a bin especially needs the braid). braid_eat's preset at a fallen street bin, worked from its stand (GarbageSearch, one block out from the bin): she turns her braid side well toward the bin and leans in, the tuft reaches into the dark mouth of the fallen can (pick: the real piece leaves the bin into the tuft once, drawn at tip), pulls it out and up in front of her face (lift) and brings it to her lips (mouth: tuft to mouth, the meal starts), then chews. Tilt stays within 9 degrees.
triggers: GarbageSearch take at a fallen bin, for a braided body (strongly preferred over the mouth)

bin_sniff.label: 围着垃圾桶嗅
bin_sniff.lore: Project design (GarbageSearch SNIFF, the beat before a ram or a rummage; user 2026-11-17 feedback 25 on FG-10): standing at the bin, it stretches its nose toward the can and takes two quick sniffs (short height pulses), turns to one side of the rim and sniffs there, swings over to the other side and sniffs again, then lifts its head with an open smile: it smells something. Starts and ends at rest, so lunge_ram, braid_eat_bin or bin_nose_in follow it directly. Pitch and roll stay within 7.5 degrees; the forward reach stays within the body.
triggers: GarbageSearch SNIFF at a standing or fallen bin (activity house_sniff)

bin_nose_in.label: 把脸伸进倒下的垃圾桶里翻找
bin_nose_in.lore: Project design (GarbageSearch NOSE_IN at a fallen bin, the mouth route; user 2026-11-17 feedback 25 on FG-10). A small eager rise and draw-back (launch), lean in until the face meets the bin's open mouth (contact), face pressed into it with pursed lips, wriggling side to side and digging with short pumps while it feels for the piece (a physical press: the front stays on the mouth plane and the body squeezes in behind it), then yank back out with the chin up and the find held in the closed mouth (pull = impact: the piece leaves the bin into the mouth), and settle into eat's first pose (lean end_lean with eat's mouth_comp), so the eat loop takes over unseen. Travel belongs to the motor (the RamContact front sweep of this clip, as glass_press); the clip's own forward shift stays within the body. Pitch and roll together stay within 10 degrees. Markers: launch, contact, impact and pull (the same instant), settled.
triggers: GarbageSearch NOSE_IN at a fallen bin's mouth (activity house_scavenge), the mouth route

puku_teary.label: 噗咕·含泪硬撑

comfort_lick.label: 担心地舔舐安抚

It soothes mood and stress only and does not treat wounds (N65 limits: licking is not a general treatment).

Whole-body pitch is at most 8 degrees (v26): effort is squash, a small forward shift, shiver and the face. The server clock freezes all presentation when blocked.

boat_labor.lore: Eyes squeezed, mouth open and sequential emergence (CAD, ムセイあき, AV references in viviparous-comics.md). Project timing (original): 12 s clip, frames 7-12 s the lead-in of labour signs afloat, frames 0-7 s one child's cycle with birth at 4.6 s. Whole-body pitch at most 8 degrees (v26). Own-hat birth (user 2026-11-04 feedback 8, interactions/aquatic-marisa-hat/layout.py hat_birth): the newborn drops into the basin straight before her and she leans 3 degrees over it without turning (a turn swings her face over the measured landing band); markers exit (the newborn leaves the outlet, the shared birth tick) and land (it reaches the basin floor after the measured drop). The server clock freezes all presentation when blocked.

hat_cradle.label: 帽中幼体
triggers: young aboard the mother's hat boat; quiet play on a brim spot facing outward

think.label: 思考
think.lore: Project design for exam thinking: slow side-to-side tilt of at most 8 degrees, a 20 degree yaw and sideways sway, slight squash, eyes up (face does the looking up, body pitch stays about 3.5 degrees).

nervous.label: 紧张
nervous.lore: Project design for pre-exam jitters: small quick left-right shuffles and tiny hops, body slightly shrunk (cf. tremble, special-events fear).

proud.label: 得意
proud.lore: Project design of the ehhen (えっへん) pose: the pride is a vertical stretch of the round body with only 5-7 degrees of lean back, hold, settle with a small overshoot (Marisa smug face, M02/EH25 style).

home_declare.label: 住家宣言（嚣张）
home_declare.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-17 feedback 21: the home declaration is exaggerated, richer, with a cocky, proud face; it puffs only when someone offends it; ここをゆっくりプレイスにするよ!): an arrival bounce into the new home, the chest thrown out in a tall stretch with the chin up for the line (marker declare), a wide show-off turn to one side and the other looking down on everything in sight (show_off), two bounces in place, the second the higher with the strongest squash-stretch (bounce), then a nose-up snort and a long smug hold with a small proud wiggle (hold). The braid flourishes out, Reimu's sideburns flare and Chen's tails stand high and swish. No cheek puff: the offended branch plays the shared puff aimed at the offender. Squash comes only from take-off and landing; pitch and roll together stay within 10.5 degrees.
triggers: home declaration of a plain or proud individual (HomeClaim.declareHome)

home_declare_timid.label: 住家宣言（胆小）
home_declare_timid.lore: Project design (feedback 21, the timid individual's short declaration): it peeks round to one side and the other first, slightly lowered, to make sure nobody is about; then a small stretch with the chin up and a brave little smug face for the line (marker declare), one small happy hop and a smug settle. No cheek puff. Pitch stays within 4 degrees.
triggers: home declaration of a timid individual (HomeClaim.declareHome)

joy_jump.label: 欢呼跳
joy_jump.lore: Project design: two consecutive high hops with clear anticipation squash, stretch in the air and landing squash; the body only tips about 4.5 degrees in the air (cf. shiawase hop, EH25 delight).

sulk.label: 闹别扭
sulk.lore: Project design: body turned about 150 degrees from the front and slightly sunk; once per cycle, on the cry face, one slow sob heaves the body up, dips it and turns it further away (a hmph), with no fast shudder (cf. droop, TM02).

hide_face.label: 藏头露腚
hide_face.lore: Project design of the head-hidden gag: crouched low with the front pushed into the box (forward shift, shorter in depth, wider), a gentle nose-down pitch of about 9 degrees so the rear reads as raised, wiggling by yaw of 6 degrees, roll of 2 degrees and a small push-in pulse. The closed-eyes smile reads as squeezed eyes. Total pitch and roll stay under 12 degrees.
triggers: exam: hiding from the question or failure

beg.label: 乞求
beg.lore: Project design of the eyes-up ground-hugging plea (贴地抬眼): body low, wide and flat, pleading eyes from the face, and each bounce a tiny forward hop with a rise of the squash. Total pitch stays within 7 degrees (cf. tremble begging in special-events).

bow.label: 鞠躬
bow.lore: Project design: polite forward bow of about 12 degrees with a squash and a small forward shift, and back up (cf. greet nod).

boat_alarm_call.label: 摇船受惊呼子回帽
boat_alarm_call.lore: The actual synchronized alarm starts with a short brace and frightened family call. No root travel is supplied by this clip.

boat_alarm_wait.label: 警戒回望等子归帽
boat_alarm_wait.lore: Keep a low supported posture, watch the actual danger and call again while the server waits for heard children or real rescue.

boat_answer_call.label: 小子油闻声回应
boat_answer_call.lore: A child's real staggered response to its parent's heard alarm; its own hat then follows the existing physical return route.

boat_flee.label: 离摇船者撤离警戒
boat_flee.lore: Face only accompanies a successful real water route away from the source. Actual paddling retains boat_paddle and its real stick; this clip supplies a stationary guarded fallback.
triggers: boat_flee with an actual retreat route

boat_calm.label: 离险后逐渐安心
boat_calm.lore: Only the real alarm's safe-distance eighty-tick phase relaxes the supported posture and face; no early reward or movement is invented.

braid_rescue_reach.label: 实单辫伸梢接触落水子
braid_rescue_reach.lore: Project design (lily-pad hull 2026-11-01): the body stays level (root rotation 0, braid_rescue.json); the braid goes from its rest over the brim down to the water just past the brim edge, where a floating child is touched (marker contact).

braid_rescue_hold.label: 同梢贴水抓托沿帽缘回护
braid_rescue_hold.lore: Project design (lily-pad hull 2026-11-01): the tuft holds at the water (marker grip), lifts high over the brim (lift_start) and sets the child on the front-right brim (place), the farthest the braid reaches; the seat is the server's.

braid_rescue_settle.label: 辫梢放回真帽面松开
braid_rescue_settle.lore: Project design (lily-pad hull 2026-11-01): the tuft rests on the front-right brim until release (marker release), then lifts and lays back out over the brim (boat_braid rest).

water_hat_flip.label: 落水脱帽翻船
water_hat_flip.lore: Retired v14: the server no longer uses this clip, kept so old saves and previews still resolve. The same braid tip first reaches and grips the worn rim, then turns the hat outside the body around that contact and lowers it onto the water; SelfRescueHatGeometry owns the entire hat and braid path. The body frame stays stable and no independent centre lerp is applied.

hat_transfer.destination: synchronized fixed DeployX/Y/Z + DeployYaw; same physical hat at deployment
hat_transfer.failure: return only the still-worn same hat from actual RemovalProgress; deployed hats are never duplicated

water_hat_grip.label: 嘴含帽缘稳住呼吸
water_hat_grip.lore: Mouth hold on the rim (project original, not canon): the head rides a few degrees low (pitch -6) and the braids only touch; the body stays at the server's contact point, with no upward animation track.

water_hat_climb.label: 沿真实帽檐爬入
water_hat_climb.lore: Project original (water 11 ruling): self-rescue climb (reworked; replaces the retired v14 press-and-relax pose). The mouth bites the brim, the braid swings forward over it and its tuft hooks down outside the rim, then two pulls lift the body (squash, stretch, a small lift) ready for hat_slide_over. Pitch <= 9, roll <= 2.

shy.label: 害羞
shy.lore: Project design: the face turns about 40 degrees away with a small side sway and drift, and peeks back once per cycle; no squash, pitch stays under 4 degrees.
triggers: matchmaking meeting, breeding permit granted, wild request

doze_off.label: 迷糊瘫软
doze_off.lore: Project design: heavy eyelids, three small nods of at most 6 degrees, slowly sinking and flattening; it ends exactly in the sleep pose (height 0.94, slump -3, tilt 4) so the sleep clip continues without a pop.
triggers: Ramune spray taking effect (90 ticks before sleep)

struggle.label: 挣扎抗拒
struggle.lore: Project design: fast yaw wiggles of 15 degrees with squash and stretch and tiny hops, roll under 5 degrees; refusing, not falling over.
triggers: refusing to enter the transport basket

basket_in.label: 钻进篮子
basket_in.lore: Project design: crouch, then a small forward hop with squash into the basket (the server hides the entity afterwards); pitch about 5 degrees in the air.

basket_out.label: 出篮张望
basket_out.lore: Project design: a small hop out, a settling squash, then a look left and right (yaw 25 degrees) with surprise turning to a smile.

ignore.label: 不理会
ignore.lore: Project design: calmly turns the whole body about 78 degrees away with eyes closed, drawn up tall with the chin up at most 5 degrees, holds, then turns back partway.
triggers: calmly ignoring a wild yukkuri's begging or provocation

restrain.label: 忍住
restrain.lore: Project design: a tense, slightly compressed body with a fine shiver and a lean back of only 3 degrees, glancing away; the predator holds itself back from a protected yukkuri.
triggers: well-behaved predator restraining itself from a protected yukkuri

water_hat_pull.label: 抓稳帽缘分两次使劲抬身
water_hat_pull.lore: Retired v14: the server no longer uses this clip, kept so old saves and previews still resolve. Two effort pulses match server LIFT displacement; breathing pauses cause no horizontal sliding. Braid contact stays on the same real brim.

water_hat_over.label: 腹部越过帽檐再落稳
water_hat_over.lore: Retired v14: the server no longer uses this clip, kept so old saves and previews still resolve. First compress the belly over the supported rim, pause, then ease onto the inner floor. No extra root lift or horizontal translation.

hat_brim_offer.label: 亲油压低近缘，等孩子靠上来
hat_brim_offer.lore: Project original (not canon): the captain sits her weight toward the near rim while the hull dips (HatBoatEntity dip, at most 5 degrees). Pitch -4.5, roll 3, yaw 3, squash h .94 w 1.04; the right braid keeps holding the stick out of the water outboard (props.paddle).

hat_hop_up.label: 小步急跳上帽檐
hat_hop_up.lore: Crouch (h .88, w 1.065, pitch -4), spring (stretch, pitch -6 to +3) and a compressed landing. HatBoarding supplies the arc, limited to .08 of the body size; no lift here. EH07-006 and EH10-008 for the small quick hop.

hop_leg.label: 一步跳（起跳、空中、落地缓冲）
hop_leg.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-04 feedback 10: one hop onto the brim, one onto the bank, a little slower so it reads). The Hop action's clip for every species: crouch until takeoff, the stretched air pose from takeoff to land (the presentation holds it for the physical airtime; the server owns the arc, so no lift here), then the landing squash and recovery until settled. hat_hop_up's crouch and spring, slower.

water_bob_lunge.label: 水中蹿身，一次顶上近缘
water_bob_lunge.lore: Project original: one darting surge while the mouth holds the dipped rim, squash h .86 then stretch h 1.11, pitch -8 to +1, roll 4. Both ends match so it can repeat; HatBoarding LIFT plays it twice (.58 and .42 pull split) and owns the path.

hat_slide_over.label: 贴着帽缘滑进帽里
hat_slide_over.lore: Project original zuri-zuri: belly pressed on the rim (h .85, w 1.08), yaw wriggle 8 degrees, pitch -8 to 0. HatBoarding SETTLE keeps the lowest point on real support.

water_mouth_grip.label: 咬住帽檐含稳
water_mouth_grip.lore: Project original (not canon): the mouth bites a rim edge of the parent hat or the child's small hat. Head rides back, pitch +5; squash h .95; braids only touch. Contact is the mouth point within mouth_reach (braid_rescue.json) for 8 continuous ticks.

water_hat_shake.label: 甩头抖落帽子
water_hat_shake.lore: Shake the worn hat off: three yaw swings of 14 degrees at 2.5 Hz with squash, pitch within 2. The server drops the same single hat onto the planned water point; no braid takes the hat.

water_hat_push.label: 从下往外顶翻帽子
water_hat_push.lore: Project original: the head and body push the upturned hat from below, squash then stretch, pitch -8, roll 4. Three pushes (PushIndex 0 to 2) each add a third of the righting progress.

boat_nudge_young.label: 亲油贴身一顶
boat_nudge_young.lore: Project original: a short chest-first nudge at the child's back (forward shift under .06 block, stretch, pitch -8). Never a lift or a carry; the right braid keeps holding the stick out of the water outboard (props.paddle).

water_held_breath.label: 被辫梢托住时喘息与小幅回应
water_held_breath.lore: Held young retain the server grip and body envelope. Small lock responses and breathing faces continue without a second root motion or body scaling.

boat_prepare_carry.label: Carry preparation
boat_prepare_carry.lore: The child stays on its actual supporting patch while tucking its hat away from the approaching parent; after set-down it unfolds only after the parent retreats. Root landing compensation comes from the fitted selected mesh.

boat_release_carry.label: Carry release
boat_release_carry.lore: The child stays on its actual supporting patch while tucking its hat away from the approaching parent; after set-down it unfolds only after the parent retreats. Root landing compensation comes from the fitted selected mesh.

snatch_pull.label: 咬住饰物拽走
snatch_pull.lore: Project design for the badge arc B8: a quick bite-and-yank at an accessory. A short draw-back, a darting forward-up lunge with a small hop (stretch), then a tug back with a squash, a yaw shake and a roll shiver. Pitch stays within 6 degrees; the effort is squash, stretch, shift and yaw.
triggers: badge arc snatch: the thief pulls the target's accessory loose

stand_ground.label: 扎稳不退
stand_ground.lore: Project design for badge arcs B5/B9: refusing to yield and guarding the nest. Planted wide and low, the chest swollen by at most 6 percent, a lean of only 4 degrees, a firm stomp-hop every 0.8 s and a slow glare left and right.
triggers: badge arc home claim defence and stand-off

offer_bite.label: 递出一口
offer_bite.lore: Project design for badge arc B4: the pet gives a mouthful to another. Lean in, push the mouth area forward with a squash, hold it out, then settle back. Pitch stays within 7 degrees; the reach is translation and squash.
triggers: badge arc beg_bite: the pet hands over a bite

braid_reach_low.label: 亲油把辫子一侧压低，够水里的赤油
braid_reach_low.lore: Project original (not canon), 2026-10-18: an infant floats low beside the hull, below a standing parent's braid reach. She sinks her braid side toward it: the pose is braid_rescue.json reach_lean (roll -10 toward the braid, pitch -5, squash h .84, a small shift and the floor lift), eased in over 0.4 s and then held; whole-body tilt about 11.2 degrees. The server's braid root uses the same pose, so the visible braid root is where the reach is measured. Played in reverse (time running back to 0) as she rises again in SETTLE.
triggers: BraidRescue REACH, GRIP, PUSH, SLIDE with the braid grip (parent); SETTLE reversed

braid_cradle_lift.label: 辫梢卷兜托起幼油
braid_cradle_lift.lore: Project original (water 11 ruling; lily-pad hull 2026-11-01): the braid reaches out over the brim beside the hull to the young in the water, scoops it, lifts it over the brim and sets it on the front-right brim (as far as the braid reaches; the transfer moves it on to its seat), then lays back out over the brim (braid_path, boat_braid rest). Body lean <= 6 with yaw toward the braid side, edging forward off the stern wall; the young is moved by the server transfer, the pose only shows the scoop.

braid_head_set.label: 辫梢把幼油放上头顶
braid_head_set.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-04: babies that do not fit the basin, or have grown, go on her head; modelled on the brim set-down, the braid's endpoint on her head instead of the brim). braid_cradle_lift's structure and markers: she leans to her braid side to take the child (contact_closed), comes upright and sinks a little as the braid raises it over her head (lift_start..lift_end), swings it in over the crown (over_end), sets it on the hair top with a small weight bob (place) and lets go (release). The server owns the child's path; the braid follows the held child at run time. After the release the braid lifts off her crown out over her braid side (laid on the arc, 0.3 s) and turns down to its rest over the brim (a "turn" key, root first, 0.4 s: braid_head_take's rise played back); a straight turn crown -> rest would swing it through her forehead.

braid_head_take.label: 辫梢把头顶的幼油抱下来
braid_head_take.lore: Project design: braid_head_set run backwards through its own markers (mirror: [take second, set second]); the braid closes on the head rider (contact_closed), lifts it off the crown (lift_end), swings it out on the braid side (over_end), lowers it to the destination (place) and lets go (release). The server owns the path. The braid rises off its rest over the brim to a point out over her braid side above the brim as a "turn" key (0.45 s, tuft first, then the root), then is laid on the arc in onto her crown (0.25 s; braid_head_set's return after its release is the same played back): laid on the arc, the bulge would flip side as the chord swings through upright and whip the braid round.

braid_brim_lift.label: 辫梢兜起幼油送到帽檐外沿
braid_brim_lift.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-05/11-06: the braid must not pass through her body or hat and must move as one living motion; a full brim side lets the braid only touch the hat and the young move onto it itself). Her braid is too short and thick to reach over her own brim, so it never tries: she leans and looks to her braid side, the tuft curls under the young on the ground beside her (contact) and closes (lift_start), swings it out and up in one arc outside her body (lift_end, beside the brim edge) and holds it level with the brim just outside the edge (place) while it steps onto the brim (release), then falls back to rest. The young rides on the tuft end (clip field tip). Chain key poses and gate: braid_keys.py.

braid_brim_lower.label: 幼油踏上辫梢、辫梢送回地面
braid_brim_lower.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-05/11-06: one living motion, no move-stop-reverse; the young stays visible). One loop beside her: the braid rises close outside her cheek to the brim edge (contact), the young steps off the brim onto the tuft (lift_start), the braid swings it out wide (lift_end) and down in one arc beside her braid side (over_end) to the ground or nest (place), the tuft under and behind it, slides out (release) and falls back to rest. Never retraces the way up. Chain key poses and gate: braid_keys.py.

be_cradled.label: 被辫梢兜着
be_cradled.lore: Project original: a young held in the curled tuft sags into the scoop (wider and lower), slightly limp, swaying a little; its place follows the carrier and the hull.

mouth_bite_hold.label: 咬住并拖拽
mouth_bite_hold.lore: Project original (water 11 ruling): the mouth bites a brim or a young's headwear and holds it with two hard backward yanks per loop (a quick heave back, squashed and widened, then a slower ease forward; about 4.2 model units of travel): righting a capsized hat, pulling a drifting young back, handing food. Species without a braid use only this. Pitch -8..-3; the biting face is puff (lips pressed shut, cheeks puffed), falling back to chewing_closed.

boat_thrown.label: 翻船被甩出
boat_thrown.lore: Project original: thrown out as the hat capsizes; a stretched startle with a half yaw spin and a braid flail, then the splash squash at the marker. The server owns the arc and the water entry.

water_hat_right.label: 咬檐翻正帽子
water_hat_right.lore: Project original (water 11 ruling): righting the capsized hat (replaces water_hat_flip/push/shake for righting). Bite the near brim, heave and twist it up (yaw), then the braid swings under the rising far brim and pushes it over; let go and sit back. Pitch -6..+5, roll <= 4.

boat_cargo_stow.label: 把粮放进帽冠袋底
boat_cargo_stow.lore: Project original: head down into the opening before her to the crown larder and let the mouthful go at the bottom. Pitch to -10.

boat_cargo_fetch.label: 从帽冠袋底取粮
boat_cargo_fetch.lore: Project original: head down to the crown larder, bite one portion and bring it up. Pitch to -10.

boat_jettison.label: 推出帽檐
boat_jettison.lore: Project original: twist to the braid side and sweep spoiled food, dirt or spare cargo over the brim with the flat tuft, then a short look after it.

boat_rim_peek.label: 帽檐探头看水
boat_rim_peek.lore: Project design (ecology design D 3.4, boat_rim_peek): a baby or small child on the bow perch by day leans out over the front rim to watch the water, stretched 4 % and tipped 7 degrees toward it, scanning left and right with two excited little hops, then turns 60 degrees to glance back over its shoulder at its mother and returns to the water; it stays forward off the wall and its braid lies out over the brim (boat_braid rest). Pitch + roll <= 8.5.
triggers: young on a brim spot facing radially outward, or on the captain's bare head facing outward (no contact)

kid_brim_splash.label: 帽檐边辫子拍水
kid_brim_splash.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-01: lively, cute 子油 play on the parent's boat; derived from boat_rim_peek and water_struggle): a 子油 on the brim ring, braid side to the water, leans about 10 degrees out and slaps the water twice with its braid; the tuft dips under the waterline at the slaps, the body stays over the brim.
triggers: 赤油 on a brim spot (art-a1-places brim ring), braid side (+x) radially outward, afloat; not on the head

kid_mimic_paddle.label: 学着亲油用辫子划水
kid_mimic_paddle.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-01; derived from boat_paddle): a 子油 on the brim copies its mother's stroke with its own braid and no stick, small and a little clumsy: the tuft sweeps fore and aft over the water and skims it mid-pull (marker dip).
triggers: 赤油 on a brim spot while the captain paddles, braid side (+x) radially outward; not on the head

kid_hide_behind.label: 受惊躲到亲油辫子下
kid_hide_behind.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-01; derived from boat_alarm_wait and boat_flee): scared, a 子油 scoots to its mother with a crouch-spring hop (the server moves it; markers scoot_start..scoot_land) and cowers low under her braid, trembling, peeking out once (peek); held cowering from tucked.
triggers: 赤油 afloat scared (threat, hit, thunder): on a brim spot facing the captain, the server moving it along the brim toward her braid side; on her head in place (the scoot hop stays in place)

mouth_release.label: 灵梦张口放出幼油
mouth_release.lore: Project design (rule 灵梦口含多只; user 2026-11-04 feedback 1: Reimu's release was barely visible). She bows low toward the ground and gapes (open), the young slides out over her lower lip from inside her mouth (open..release, 13 ticks), drops free with a small push (release), then she rises and her mouth closes (closed). Same beat length as Marisa's braid set-down (braid_cradle_lift place..release, braid_rescue_settle). Pitch <= 8; the gape is squash and the face.
triggers: ParentCarry MOUTH set-down (Reimu, live hidden passenger)

braid_item_hold.label: 辫梢攥着物品（陆上）
braid_item_hold.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-04 feedback 6: holding an item is a general ability shown in the grip, the braid for Marisa; a stick taken on the bank is held in the braid, not hidden). Overlay: the braid curls up beside her cheek on her braid side (clear of her lips) and its tuft grips the real held stack (props.item, the paddle's grip and twig frame) shouldered: long end up, out and back past the brim; the body plays its own idle or walk under it.
triggers: real held stack in the braid, ashore (idle and walking)

braid_item_pick.label: 辫梢拾起物品
braid_item_pick.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-04 feedback 6: holding an item is a general ability shown in the grip, the braid for Marisa; a stick taken on the bank is held in the braid, not hidden). She leans and looks a little to her braid side, the tuft reaches the item lying beside her on her braid side (contacts.braid_grip), closes on it (contact: the real stack moves from the ground into the braid once), and lifts it to the hold (lift_end); the clip ends on braid_item_hold's pose.
triggers: real item pickup with the braid (ground or bank item)

braid_item_place.label: 辫梢放下物品
braid_item_place.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-04 feedback 6: holding an item is a general ability shown in the grip, the braid for Marisa; a stick taken on the bank is held in the braid, not hidden). braid_item_pick in reverse: from the hold the tuft lowers the item to the ground beside her on her braid side and opens (release: the real stack leaves the braid once), then the braid hangs free again.
triggers: real item set-down from the braid

mouth_item_pick.label: 低头用嘴叼起物品
mouth_item_pick.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-04 feedback 6: holding an item is a general ability shown in the grip; the mouth for bodies without a braid). She bows and sinks so her lips reach an item lying before her, bites (bite: the real stack moves from the ground into the mouth once) and comes back up holding it; the held stack is drawn at the mouth anchor. Pitch <= 8; the reach is squash and a forward shift.
triggers: real item pickup with the mouth (ground or bank item)

mouth_item_place.label: 低头把嘴里的物品放下
mouth_item_place.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-04 feedback 6: holding an item is a general ability shown in the grip; the mouth for bodies without a braid). mouth_item_pick in reverse: she bows, opens her lips over the ground before her (release: the real stack leaves the mouth once) and straightens.
triggers: real item set-down from the mouth

boat_puff.label: 帽船上鼓气威吓
boat_puff.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-04 feedback 2: parents puff at an attacker; the triage item 2 check): the land puff lifts and swells 15% and leaves the braid at its land rest, which sinks it 1.5 model units into the hull aboard. Seated variant: puff face, a 5% swell with a small tremble and a 3 degree glare toward the attacker (the body yaw), no hop, the braid laid out at its boat rest.
triggers: protective puff while seated in the hat boat

thunder_cower.label: 雷暴缩身
thunder_cower.lore: Project design (TODO 陆 14 thunderstorm): flattened low and wide under a roof, leaning back from the open side and trembling with eyes squeezed; it rises a little and peeks out with a small look aside (yaw only), then a rumble flattens it again. Pitch back at most 4, roll at most 1.5.
triggers: sheltered alone in a thunderstorm while frightened (Reactions.Weather HUDDLE without a partner)

sunbathe.label: 晒太阳
sunbathe.lore: Project design (art-dir-life 晒太阳): a chilled body settles flat in a patch of winter sun with its face turned a little up and eyes closed, breathes slowly with a soft sway, and rounds back up warm at the end. The bask lasts this clip (TemperatureLife BASK_TICKS). Pitch up at most 4, roll at most 2.
triggers: cold, a clear day, a sunlit stand reached (TemperatureLife refuge with sun)

rain_huddle_right.label: 雨中贴靠（同伴在右）
rain_huddle_right.lore: Project design (TODO 陆 14, art-dir-life rain_huddle): pressed against a kin or friend under a roof in the rain. Each cycle opens with a nestle (squash low and wide, slide and lean into the partner, eyes squeezed), then holds pressed with a shiver that is not mirrored, so a pair started on one clip clock shivers in step, and a slow breath with calmer half-closed eyes; it eases back to the held pose at the seam. The worn hat remains seated on the head and follows only the body pose. Real posed brim, hair and ribbon surfaces determine the contact spacing; cheek contact must not force accessories through each other. A thunder clap restarts the cycle after the startle, which reads as nestling closer. side +1: the partner is toward model +X, the body's right (the game turns the model by 180 - yaw, its face is -Z).
triggers: weather huddle pressed (Reactions.Weather HUDDLE), partner on its right

rain_huddle_left.label: 雨中贴靠（同伴在左）
triggers: weather huddle pressed (Reactions.Weather HUDDLE), partner on its left

cling_right.label: 依偎贴靠（同伴在右）
cling_right.lore: Project design (motion library base cling, art decision B5/C6; wiki warm_huddle F05, F14, L36 and rub_nuzzle F14, L36, N2): the rain huddle's side-press (nestle, slide and lean into the partner, pressed hold, slow breath) held calm with no shiver and a closed-eye smile. Snuggling assembles it with nuzzle and sway.
triggers: no caller (snuggle_right carries the bonded pair's side-press), partner on its right

cling_left.label: 依偎贴靠（同伴在左）
triggers: no caller (snuggle_left), partner on its left

nod.label: 点头
nod.lore: Project design (motion library base nod, art decision B3; wiki greeting_bow N1, F17, L36): the bow at half its pitch, two quick dips, a small height dip and forward shift so it reads at real size; a busy yukkuri's reply to a greeting.
triggers: no caller yet (greeting reply while busy)

stamp.label: 跺脚
stamp.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-14: the refused stray pleads, stamps and cries): a planted tantrum stamp without hands. The body pulls up stretched, tipped to one side, and slams down onto the ground twice, the second stamp higher, harder and tipped to the other side; the squash is the real impact, never airborne (it must not read as a hop). Then it fumes, swelling slightly with a short hmph turn away, and settles upright. Pitch and roll together stay within 9 degrees; the face is the caller's.

walk_look_back.label: 边走边回头
walk_look_back.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-14: the stray finally leaves slowly looking back; after sharing it looks once more before parting): played in place of the walk while the body travels. Two rocking steps per 1.2 s gait cycle as in the walk; after the first steps the whole ball (no neck) yaws about 105 degrees back over its shoulder toward what it leaves, lingers with the steps damped and the face a little raised, turns forward again and walks on. The travel belongs to the motor; the clip's rotation composes with the travel heading. Pitch and roll stay within 3 degrees; the face is the caller's.

run.label: 跑
run.lore: Project design (motion library base run; wiki ground locomotion L36, F27, F09 and rain running N1, F05): the fast grounded gait of a ball without legs. Two quick low bounds per cycle, each a short crouch, a stretched flat arc and a squashed landing, the body pitched forward the whole way (deepest at each push-off) and rocking a little from side to side. Faster and flatter than the hop, never the rocking steps of the waddle. The travel belongs to the motor. Pitch and roll together stay within 8 degrees; the face is the caller's.

reject_or_spit.label: 吐出拒食
reject_or_spit.lore: Project design (motion library base reject_or_spit; wiki picky eating and food refusal): the mouth throws the food back out, independent of the chew and swallow loop. It starts on the tick the real item leaves the mouth (marker release): the body jabs forward and down, flattened by the push, so the dropped item appears in front of the lips; then it rears back and up away from the taste, shakes the whole ball no-no-no with a fading yaw, and ends with a short hmph turned aside before settling. No hop, never airborne. Pitch and roll together stay within 9 degrees; the face is the caller's.
triggers: refused meal spat out (LifeMeal.spit, the real dropped item)

farewell.label: 道别
farewell.lore: Project design (motion library composite farewell = turn + droop; wiki leaving and farewell S03, L36): a parting played in place, facing what it leaves at the start and at the end. It sinks a little, turns the whole ball (no neck) away with two heavy rocking steps as if to go, stops, then turns back over its shoulder and stretches up to look, held; it turns to go again, quicker, and looks back a second time, further round and taller, held longer; then it gives up, comes round to face it and droops low and forward, held, before settling. The walking version is walk_look_back. Pitch and roll together stay within 8 degrees; the face is the caller's.
triggers: giving up the vigil at the glass (GlassVigil FAREWELL, Behaviors.GLASS_FAREWELL)

snuggle_right.label: 依偎（同伴在右）
snuggle_right.lore: Project design (motion library composite snuggle = cling + nuzzle + sway; wiki warm_huddle F05, F14, L36 and rub_nuzzle F14, L36, N2): the calm side-press of cling, then a cheek rub while still pressed (the body slides forward and back along the partner, rolling into it with each stroke; the slide is mirrored by side, so two partners on one clip clock slide against each other), then one slow sway that is not mirrored, so the pressed pair rocks together as one. Closed-eye smile, melting on each stroke. The snuggle holds the press and slides farther in than the rain huddle. SideContact uses the snuggle's fitted side profiles for different body scales or support heights. Pitch and roll together stay within 12 degrees.
triggers: a bonded pair's side-press at the start of a nuzzle (DailyLife.contactClip), partner on its right

snuggle_left.label: 依偎（同伴在左）
triggers: a bonded pair's side-press at the start of a nuzzle (DailyLife.contactClip), partner on its left

lunge_ram.label: 前冲撞击
lunge_ram.lore: Project design (motion library base lunge_ram, art decision B1/C2; wiki defense_flee and home invasion pushes N1, F15, F07): crouch and draw back (wind-up), dart forward stretched with a small hop (launch), flatten on the near contact face (impact: the front stays at the dart's farthest point and the body squeezes in behind it, a physical squash), spring back with a recoil hop and settle. Travel belongs to the motor; the clip's own forward shift stays within the body. front_ratio is the rest face front ahead of the root pivot over the body height (rounded body 6.07/9.6, bean 5.11/13.14). Markers: launch, impact (hit timing), settled.
triggers: bash at a pane (motor Bash: every stroke of the family glass ram, RamContact.CLIP)

glass_press.label: 玻璃挤脸
glass_press.lore: Project design (user: glass face-squish): a body behind a pane presses toward someone or something it wants. Eager rise and small draw-back, lean in until the face meets the glass (contact), squash flat against it with one slow extra push (a physical squash; the front stays on the pane while the body behind it squeezes in), peel back with a small sticky stretch and settle. Travel belongs to the motor (GlassPress, from the RamContact front sweep of this clip); the clip's own forward shift stays within the body. Markers: launch, contact, impact (peel starts), settled.
triggers: an approach goal reaching its glass stand with the wanted one beyond the pane (shop window plea, family glass vigil)

crouch_watch.label: 蹲守
crouch_watch.lore: Project design (motion library composite crouch_watch: idle + call_child + look_around): a body keeping watch at a pane it cannot pass. It sits settled and slightly low facing the glass and breathes, gathers and stretches up toward the pane to peer through with a small quiver (the voiced call stays the caller's call_child), settles, glances away over one side (yaw only) and back, and holds again; it loops. Pitch and roll together stay within 5 degrees; the face is the caller's.
triggers: family glass vigil between calls (GlassVigil WAIT, the answering child at its stand)

crouch_watch_weary.label: 蹲守（耐心将尽）
crouch_watch_weary.lore: Project design (crouch_watch as patience runs out, a preset of it): the same watch sunk lower with the face hanging, a slow sway, one weak lift of the face toward the pane that does not reach the full stretch, and a smaller, slower glance away. Pitch and roll together stay within 11 degrees.
triggers: family glass vigil in its last seconds (GlassVigil WAIT near its deadline)

mood_flutter.label: 开心摆发
mood_flutter.lore: Emotional hair and tail display, happy (motion library base emotional_hair and chen_tail_signal; L36 hair moving with mood, F151 Reimu's sideburns ぴこぴこ, L03/F74 Chen's tails showing her mood): a small buoyant stretch with a light side-to-side rock while the appendage shows the feeling. Marisa's braid lifts out and flutters with a wave running down it, Reimu's sideburns flick, Chen's two tails rise and wag; other forms show only the body. The braid display gives way to a held item (no braid_use). Pitch and roll together stay within 6 degrees; the face is the caller's.
triggers: face-only happy beats (a parent hearing first words, a pat or a gift from a person)

mood_flick.label: 生气甩发
mood_flick.lore: Emotional hair and tail display, angry (emotional_hair, chen_tail_signal; project design): the body pulls up, swells slightly and leans in while the appendage snaps. Marisa's braid cracks out twice and stays bristling away from the body, Reimu's sideburns flare and quiver, Chen's tails shoot up stiff with a sharp flick (the same raised tail that announces an intention). Pitch stays within 4 degrees; the face is the caller's.
triggers: face-only angry beats (sanction finished, scorn at a mouldy one, a refused peer)

mood_droop.label: 难过垂发
mood_droop.lore: Emotional hair and tail display, sad or guilty (emotional_hair, chen_tail_signal; L03 Chen's lowered tail after the stolen snack): the face sinks and the appendage hangs. Marisa's braid and Reimu's sideburns fall limp forward beside the cheek, Chen's tails drop low and barely move. Pitch and roll together stay within 9 degrees; the face is the caller's.
triggers: face-only sad beats (a child that cannot be fed, a refused offering, an exile's plea refused)

cough_mukyu.label: 咳嗽（姆Q）
cough_mukyu.lore: Patchouli's cough (motion library base cough_mukyu; frail, asthmatic Patchouli, むきゅー, komicolle 40720 floor 11518905): three convulsive coughs, each a short gasp up and a jerk forward and down with the body clenched by the spasm (a physical contraction, not a mood), the last the deepest; then she stays bent, panting, and slowly straightens. Her cheek locks tremble with the effort (lock_tremble). Pitch and roll together stay within 11 degrees; the face is the caller's.
triggers: Patchouli retching (SpeciesLife.vomit: a gulped meal brings the filling back up)

sukkiri_after_dazed.label: 素鸡立后满足（父方）
sukkiri_after_dazed.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-13: the peak is held 3 s in the climax clip, then the satisfied face): 120 ticks after the peak, a slow contented sway, then still.
triggers: HEAT_RELIEF / contact end, father other than Marisa and Alice (wiring package)

sukkiri_after_tender.label: 素鸡立后温柔满足（母方）
sukkiri_after_tender.lore: Project design: after the held peak the mother settles straight into a tender, content face (user: gentler than satisfied).

sukkiri_after_proud.label: 素鸡立后神气（魔理沙父方）
sukkiri_after_proud.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-13: after the 3 s peak, the proud face): Marisa draws herself up tall straight away, leans back 4 degrees, gives one small bounce and settles: smug afterglow, strongest on Marisa.
triggers: HEAT_RELIEF / contact end, Marisa father (wiring package)

sukkiri_after_manic.label: 攻击后癫狂余韵（爱丽丝）
sukkiri_after_manic.lore: Project design: sated but still unhinged, Alice keeps the wide manic grin, bobs through two bursts of giggling (0.5 s bobs, no shaking: user 2026-11-13) and looks slowly about for the next one (user: no smug stage for Alice).
triggers: HEAT_RELIEVED after ALICE_ACT, and Alice as a father (wiring package)

sukkiri_pair_loop.label: 素鸡立父方·接触循环
sukkiri_pair_loop.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-13: the middle repeats many times for 5-30 s, no high-frequency shaking): one 1.6 s cycle of two even lower-body strokes (0.8 s each, out over the first 40%, back over the rest) and a slow cheek-side sway; the contact plays it as many times as the pair's contact length needs. Alice keeps her rolled-eye grin.
triggers: courtship CONTACT before the climax, father (wiring package)

sukkiri_mamu_loop.label: 素鸡立母方·接触循环
sukkiri_mamu_loop.lore: Project design: the mother answers each stroke a tick later with a small forward shove and a pressed squash (a physical push); her lean and look-back stay in the contact cue.
triggers: courtship CONTACT before the climax, mother (wiring package)

sukkiri_pair_climax.label: 素鸡立父方·四拍高潮与 3 秒峰值
sukkiri_pair_climax.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-13: 要来了...素...素...素鸡立！ on the voice rhythm, the peak held 3 s, then the proud / satisfied face): four beats that each change body and face. Build (0 s, line heat_relief_1): three strokes quickening from 0.4 to 0.3 s, then a deep press as he draws up 3% and leans back 1 degree; squeezed-shut eyes and pursed mouth. Hold (1.5 s, heat_relief_2): pressed deeper, taller, leaning back 2; squeezed eyes, open mouth. Hold (2.6 s, heat_relief_2 again): deeper still, taller, lean 3; eyes rolled up white. Release (3.5 s, heat_relief_3): springs to the full peak (9% taller, lean 4, the deepest push) with the flushed shout for the line, then the dazed face held to 6.5 s: the peak lasts 3 s with no tremble, one slow exhale, and slackens to rest over the last 0.2 s. Beat gaps 30, 22 and 18 ticks follow the ellipses of the line. Alice keeps her manic, evil faces.
triggers: courtship climax and the Alice act climax, peni role (wiring package)

sukkiri_mamu_climax.label: 素鸡立母方·四拍高潮与 3 秒峰值
sukkiri_mamu_climax.lore: Project design: the mother takes the same four beats on the same clock: each press shoves her forward a tick later and she draws up a notch with him, shouts at the release and holds the dazed peak for 3 s.

sukkiri_alice_loop.label: 攻击素鸡立爱丽丝·接触循环
sukkiri_alice_loop.lore: Project design: Alice's frantic contact cycle, two deep strokes a second (10 ticks each, still a readable pump, not a shake) with a wild side sway and the rolled-eye grin; repeated for the act's contact length.
triggers: agitation ALICE_ACT before the climax (wiring package)

sukkiri_held_loop.label: 被压住的受方·接触循环
sukkiri_held_loop.lore: Project design: the pinned body is shoved by each stroke a tick later, crying; its struggles stay the server's Pin.struggle.
triggers: agitation HELD before the climax (wiring package)

sukkiri_held_climax.label: 被压住的受方·四拍与 3 秒
sukkiri_held_climax.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-13: keep the mother pinned until the performance is complete): the held body takes Alice's four beats, each a fresh face (horror, squeezed wail, grey-eyed wail), jolts once at the release with the blank-eyed cry and stays pinned, crying, through the 3 s peak.

sukkiri_alice_chase.label: 雷普魔追击（爱丽丝）
sukkiri_alice_chase.lore: Project design (user 2026-11-13: the raper moved by sliding with no motion): Alice bounds after her target, a crouch-spring-land hop every 0.7 s (16% of her height), leaning 4 degrees into the run and throwing her face side to side with each hop, manic grin. Travel belongs to the navigation; the clip only carries the body.

sneeze_a.label: 打喷嚏
sneeze_a.lore: A sneeze in three beats: nose tickle and three escalating inhale hitches with an upward volume-keeping stretch and slight backward lean (no emotional squash), a sharp forward snap with a small hop and landing recoil, then two quick blinks and a small head shake settling cleanly to neutral rest. Composed root tilt stays within 10.9 degrees.

sneeze_b.label: 打喷嚏
sneeze_b.lore: Everyday sneeze: nose tickles and the body stretches up and leans slightly back through three escalating inhale hitches with scrunched face, snaps sharply forward with a tiny reflex hop and lands into a backward recoil with a brief physical landing cushion, then blinks, gives a small shake and settles cleanly to neutral rest. Whole-body tilt stays within 11.2 degrees.

sneeze_c.label: 打喷嚏
sneeze_c.lore: Everyday sneeze (project design): nose tickles, the body stretches upward and leans slightly back across three escalating inhale hitches while the face scrunches (eyes squeezed, mouth half open); at 0.78 s it snaps sharply forward with a tiny hop and recoils onto a brief physical landing squash, then blinks twice with a small head-clearing yaw shake before settling cleanly back to neutral rest. Composed pitch+roll stays within 10.7 degrees.

paper_pull.label: 从报纸堆抽出一张报纸
paper_pull.lore: Project design (N79, body-is-ability): standing at a newspaper bundle, it bows and bites a folded sheet edge, braces with small loosening yaw twists and pulls back at `tug` (the real sheet debits from the stack into MouthOccupancy Purpose.PAPER once), then settles upright holding the sheet in its mouth. Marisa's braid reaches down to press the bundle steady during the tug before swinging back to rest; if her braid already holds an item, the held-item pose stays and her mouth tugs alone. Composed tilt stays within 7.5 degrees.

paper_cover_under.label: 掀起报纸角钻到纸下盖身
paper_cover_under.lore: Project design (N79): resting in a cold plain gap with paper, it dips its nose to catch the sheet edge, lifts its chin to flip the folded newspaper upward, and pushes forward under it at `drape` (transferring one real paper sheet into the worn paper-cover slot) with a quick nestle before settling. Composed tilt stays within 7.5 degrees.

paper_cover_child.label: 亲油叼报纸披在赤油身上
paper_cover_child.lore: Project design (N79 two-body extension, body-is-ability): standing at its cold baby's flank in a low gap with a folded sheet in its mouth, the parent stretches slightly upward to clear the baby, bows gently forward to lay the sheet onto the baby's back at `drape` (atomically transferring one sheet from MouthOccupancy Purpose.PAPER into the baby's paperCover), and eases back with a small reassuring nod. Marisa's braid reaches beside the sheet corner when free and keeps its held-item pose when busy. Composed tilt stays within 10 degrees.

cold_shiver.label: 寒夜缩身阵阵发抖
cold_shiver.lore: Project design (N79): huddled slightly forward in a cold gap (distinct from `tremble`'s backward fear shake), with no emotional Y-squash; two involuntary 5.5 Hz cold shudder bursts per 2.4 s cycle separated by shallow cold breaths, starting and ending in the same quiet tucked hold for a seamless loop. Composed tilt stays within 6 degrees.

mood_display.lore: Hair and tails that show a mood (L36; F151 Reimu's sideburns; L03, F74 Chen's tails): a clip's `display` block gives each appendage its own keys. `out_keys` lift it away from the body (degrees; a tail rises), `forward_keys` swing it forward (tails spread apart), `wags` are [start, end, degrees, hz] oscillations on top (a tail wags sideways), `lag` delays the second tail or each braid joint and `whip` is the share of the wag every braid joint adds, so a wave runs down the braid.
mood_display.applies: braid: braid_lock_* carried by hand_right; sideburn: reimu forms whose hand bones carry hair; tail: chen_tail_left/right

braid_use.note: Project design (user 2026-11-05 feedback 2: what the braid already holds decides what it can do): clips whose own authored braid grips, carries or strokes something (the hat, a child, a brim, the water; in the water she flails and swims with it while the stack stays in her hat) use the braid, so the game never lays the held stack's hold over them; a held stack shows there only by the clip's own props.item, otherwise it stays stowed in her hat and is not drawn. A hat clip with `hat.stick` (her own hat on and off at the water, the clips the game plays while she holds the stick) keeps the stick in the tuft: it lies along the brim the tuft hooks, its long end along the keyed direction in the worn hat's frame ([t, x, y, z]: out to her braid side on the worn brim, out over the water on the hat set down; re-aimed in the tuft while the hat swings over) and turning with the hat, so the stick never leaves the braid, never pops and never crosses her face (user 2026-11-05 feedback 2; user 2026-11-04 feedback 6: held in the braid, not hidden). Markers `braid_busy` (the braid has left the hold by here) and `braid_free` (from here it returns to the hold by the clip's end) let a one-shot clip hand the braid over from and back to the hold. Exported as the clip field braid_use.
